basis: Reconciled against the current public source on 24 October 2026. Original 0.3 work-package scope retained; UI additions are not whole-package completion.

current_increment.description: Offline voice capability explanations and disabled unavailable controls; current/historical build identity; Chinese demo narration and cue coverage; consolidated 30-lesson tests; readiness reconciliation

readiness_note: Documented designs/reference kernels are not production-ready patches. One next low-risk slice was selected for implementation; no unsupported count of remaining small slices is claimed. Existing pre-0.3 application capabilities are not counted as missing merely because a proposed extension is not integrated.

documented_requirement_entries.update: Record reader/model/exporter/analysis versions, supported modes, evidence basis and exclusions per run; expose partial capabilities honestly.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: L for display; M for identity/grouping

documented_requirement_entries.update: Preserve offline native access and explicit locked inventory; document actual batch/API capability separately from simply being an unencrypted ZIP.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: L for declarations; H for access/decryption changes

documented_requirement_entries.update: Add a bounded, content-probed `.missy.zip` reader with safe archive handling, separate from ZIP batch intake and existing native readers.
Preserve exact labels, finite/null semantics, units and machine keys; add explicit precision/rounding metadata without display-rounding raw values.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: M; H if changing numeric parsing

documented_requirement_entries.update: Separate run-instance, source-byte, acquisition-content, physical-position, sample, assay, channel and analysis IDs. Names are not identities.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: M; H if used to suppress records

documented_requirement_entries.update: Preserve source hashes and CRCs, verify all package payloads, and distinguish integrity from authentication. Never replace exact hashes with normalized comparison hashes.
Represent template/locked/incomplete/aborted/completed states separately from analysis provenance; preserve time basis and clock changes.
Separate addressable sample layout from physical measurement layout, retaining orientation and all actual positions.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: H if decoder stride changes; M as sidecar

documented_requirement_entries.update: Preserve preparation, subsample, dilution and PCR replicate identities; avoid equating multiple technical wells to independent preparations.
Preserve explicit per-target control roles, crop reference assays and physical reference positions as distinct concepts; do not infer one from names.
Keep protocol/stage/step/repeat identity; use protocol-aware cohorts and never treat a setpoint as a measurement.
Bind channel IDs directly; preserve multiple acquisitions per cycle and independent raw/derivative grids.
Preserve raw and processed layers with transform lineage; never relabel Rn/Î”Rn/RFU as ADC counts.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: M as annotation; H if reprocessing

documented_requirement_entries.update: Carry measured/missing/saturated/error/not-collected/derived-interpolation states without zero filling or index shifts.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: H if replacing legacy missingness behavior

documented_requirement_entries.update: Keep value, calculation state, detection call, QC disposition, native token and output metric separate. Preserve valid last-cycle Cq versus undetermined sentinels.
Track provenance per analysis/result family, algorithm/version/settings/overrides, precision and pre-storage rounding; preserve originals and independent revisions.
Complete generic absolute/relative engine execution behind explicit models, pairing, controls, range, unit and uncertainty gates. Preserve existing MARA behavior.
Complete generic melting execution only for validated supported algorithms/chemistries; preserve own grids, peak/shoulder identity and stored versus derived status.
Preserve thermal sensor basis/specification/calibration and time resolution; use supported measured logs for existing diagnostic metrics without claiming component-failure certainty.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: M for evidence; H for metric replacement

documented_requirement_entries.update: Preserve actual exposure/gain/range/dark/reference/compensation context and coverage. Treat undocumented masks as opaque; distinguish channels from dyes.
Declare calibration axes/dimensions/index order/reserved slots; preserve validity/traceability and maintenance events; no silent correction.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: M for evidence; H for applying coefficients

documented_requirement_entries.update: Persist selections/revisions/parameter deltas with actor/time/reason; retain source data; support privacy. A local hash chain is not authenticated immutable audit storage.
Export complete supported data with scope/counts/omissions, field definitions and provenance; keep companion CSV/PDF/RDML distinct from the new complete package.
Add staged validation and per-subclaim evidence classes; do not turn unsupported/missing evidence into negative samples.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: H for new strict rejection rules

documented_requirement_entries.update: Implement structured Annex A entry/import/export and availability for all 54 existing catalogue fields; completeness must not silently become a biological failure.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: M; H if made a release gate

documented_requirement_entries.update: Implement one versioned canonical acquired-content profile and source-name diagnostics; equal content is duplicate-candidate evidence, not one acquisition ID.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: M for diagnostics; H for deduplication

documented_requirement_entries.update: Model non-sample physical roles independently, preserve their readings, and exclude them from sample results through roles. Explicit sparse masks, no fabricated samples.
Preserve original per-reading statistics/count availability and definitions. Handle variable native tuple widths; within-read SD is not replicate/between-run SD.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: L for existing-value display; H for tuple/strict changes

documented_requirement_entries.update: Add numeric representation and original-bit/lexeme evidence; round-trip acquired export to the source representation. Accept shorter exact decimals; protect signed zero where source-significant.
Remove render-order/global-counter dependence; define canonical repeated-export comparison including manifest dependencies and archive metadata; apply scoped structural self-checks.
documented_requirement_entries.production_integration_risk: M for local IDs; H for export/strict gate changes
